programs.source:
board = falses(11, 11)
    row, column, direction = 5, 5, 0
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    for step = 1:300
        direction = mod(direction+(board[row+1, column+1] ? -1 : 1), 4)
        board[row+1, column+1] = !board[row+1, column+1]
        dr, dc = directions[direction+1]
        row, column = mod(row+dr, 11), mod(column+dc, 11)
